raw: TradeID is the original trade identifier, taken directly from HH_H_T_ID and cast to INTEGER.
Not read from the source; it is the DimDate surrogate key of the batch date being loaded.
sql: (SELECT DD.SK_DateID FROM DimDate AS DD WHERE DD.DateValue = (SELECT MAX(BD.BatchDate) FROM Source.BatchDate AS BD))

raw: Pass the middle initial through, trimming whitespace and turning empty strings into NULL.
Pass the phone through unchanged apart from trimming, mapping empty strings to NULL since the column is nullable.
T_IS_CASH is '1' for cash and '0' for margin, so map it to a non-null BOOLEAN.
sql: CASE WHEN TRIM(T.T_IS_CASH) = '1' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END

raw: Copy the 3-character trade type code, trimming whitespace.
Convert the 'true'/'false' text into a BOOLEAN, case-insensitively, with NULL for anything else.
sql: CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MarketHoursFlag)) = 'true' THEN TRUE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MarketHoursFlag)) = 'false' THEN FALSE ELSE NULL END

raw: Pass the state/province through trimmed, with a NULL guard because the column is NOT NULL.
The surrogate customer key comes from the matching DimAccount row and is a GROUP BY column, so it can be selected directly.
Cast the 'HH:MM:SS' text to the TIME type.
Cast the source fiscal year to NUMERIC(4,0), treating blank text as NULL before the cast.
Take the trade quantity from T_QTY, treating blank as NULL, as NUMERIC(6,0).
Copy the cars count as NUMERIC(2), mapping blank strings to NULL since the column is nullable.
QtrStartDate is a YYYYMMDD string, so parse it into a DATE.
Take the matched prospect's credit rating as an INTEGER, NULL when blank or when there is no prospect match.
This is the Historical Load, for which the spec fixes BatchID = 1.
Copy the 6-character issue type from the Finwire security record, trimmed.
Parse the YYYYMMDD string into a DATE, giving NULL for the empty values.
The national tax rate description is the name from the TR join on C_NAT_TX_ID.
Pass the second address line through (preserving case), mapping empty strings to NULL.
Per TPC-DI, ratings AAA, AA, A, BBB (with +/-) are not low grade, BB, B, CCC, CC, C, D (with +/-) are low grade, and anything else (junk values) is unknown/NULL.
sql: CASE WHEN TRIM(CMP.SPrating) IN ('AAA','AA+','AA','AA-','A+','A','A-','BBB+','BBB','BBB-') THEN FALSE WHEN TRIM(CMP.SPrating) IN ('BB+','BB','BB-','B+','B','B-','CCC+','CCC','CCC-','CC','C','D') THEN TRUE ELSE NULL END

raw: Cast the trimmed string of diluted shares outstanding to NUMERIC(12,0).
Take the last name from NameXML, trimmed, defaulting to empty string to satisfy NOT NULL, truncated to CHAR(30).
Keep the single-character middle initial, converting empty strings to NULL and limiting to CHAR(1).
Source surrogate key is a DECIMAL so cast it to the INTEGER target type.
A row's end date is the next row's EffectiveDate for the same Symbol, or 9999-12-31 if there is no later row.
sql: COALESCE(CAST(LEAD(SecurityFinal.EffectiveDate) OVER (PARTITION BY SecurityFinal.Symbol ORDER BY SecurityFinal.EffectiveDate) AS DATE), DATE '9999-12-31')

raw: Use the trimmed postal code, defaulting to empty string for NOT NULL, truncated to CHAR(12).
Pass through the trimmed address line, treating empty as NULL, truncated to CHAR(80).
Pass through the credit card count as NUMERIC(2), NULL when missing.
Cast the trimmed inventory string to NUMERIC(15,2).
A row is current when there is no later action for the same AccountID.
sql: LEAD(AccountsFinal.ActionTS) OVER (PARTITION BY AccountsFinal.AccountID ORDER BY AccountsFinal.ActionTS) IS NULL

raw: Use the trimmed company description, defaulting to empty string for NOT NULL, truncated to CHAR(150).
Generate a unique surrogate key by numbering rows in chronological order of effective date.
sql: CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SecurityFinal.EffectiveDate, SecurityFinal.Symbol) AS INTEGER)

raw: Pass the fiscal quarter id through as NUMERIC(5).
Look up the DimDate surrogate key for the date part of the close timestamp, giving NULL for open trades.
sql: (SELECT D.SK_DateID FROM DimDate AS D WHERE D.DateValue = CAST(DimTradeStaging.SK_CloseDateID AS DATE))

Pass the trade tax through cast to NUMERIC(10,2).
